title: nixos/postgresql: add freeformType to ensureClauses option
reason: Large real removal: the ensureUsers.<n>.ensureClauses submodule's entire fixed schema (7 named options: superuser, createrole, createdb, inherit, login, replication, bypassrls, each with long docs) is REMOVED and replaced by a bare freeformType = attrsOf(oneOf[str,int,bool]) -- i.e. ensureClauses goes from a documented, named, statically-typed submodule to a fully freeform, undocumented attrset. This is the change the PR title names directly.
targets_toml: option_prefix=[services,postgresql], watch=[ensureUsers.ensureClauses]. Confirmed discovered_options never enumerates the 7 named sub-fields (superuser, createrole, etc.) at EITHER base or head -- only the parent leaf 'ensureUsers.ensureClauses' itself is visible.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: NEW STRUCTURAL BLIND SPOT, distinct from prior gap shapes: 'unchanged' both sides, but this masks a real, large removal (7 named options -> freeform) that oba cannot see at ANY point along the way. Root-caused via discovered_options: oba's walker enumerates ensureUsers's own fields (name, ensureDBOwnership, ensureClauses) since ensureUsers is a listOf(submodule) one level deep -- but it does NOT recurse a second level into ensureClauses's OWN nested submodule-with-named-options, at either base (7 named fields) or head (freeform), so the entire schema change is invisible at both ends, not just one. Naming this candidate_capability_gap: submodule discovery does not recurse past one level of nesting under a listOf/attrsOf(submodule) wrapper. This is the second gap of this general 'goes 1 level deep but not 2' shape observed this batch (see also kanidm's provision.groups.<name>.overwriteMembers from batch5, which was total non-discovery from the OUTSIDE of the wrapper; this one is non-discovery from the INSIDE, one level past where the wrapper's own fields ARE visible).
